name: Gemini Omni
desc: Conversational video creation and editing in the Gemini app
desc_zh: Gemini 应用里用对话创建和剪辑视频的功能
solves: Video edits usually mean a timeline and a tutorial; Omni changes clips by conversation, from text, photos and video.
solves_zh: 剪视频往往要学时间线操作，Omni 靠对话修改片段，输入文字、照片或视频都行。
best_for: You have phone clips from a demo and need a polished promo without opening an editor.
best_for_zh: 手里有产品演示的手机素材，想不开剪辑软件就出一条宣传片。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://gemini.google/release-notes (official Gemini Apps release updates)）。 Entry dated 2026.05.19; all Google AI subscribers globally (18+), availability varies by region. Includes a custom AI avatar. Also added to Google Vids in July 2026. Second source is not independent media. 首次公开日期来源：https://gemini.google/release-notes
